Its official values are: | Value | Meaning | |-------|---------| | `"true"` | The element is editable. | | `"false"` | The element is not editable. | | `"inherit"` | Inherit the value from the parent. | | `"plaintext-only"` | (Supported by most browsers) The element is editable, but only plain‑text input is allowed – no formatting, no pasted markup, etc. | Because `"plaintext-only"` is **not** a boolean value, you cannot legitimately convert it to `"true"` or `"false"`. …
